title: Storm warning
instructions: Radyoda fırtına uyarısı veriliyor. Bölgeleri, saatleri ve tavsiyeleri karıştırma. Bu sette 3 dinleme hakkın var.

script.speaker: host
script.text: This is a weather warning for tonight.

script.speaker: host
script.text: A big storm will arrive in the west at about nine p.m. and move east after midnight.

script.speaker: host
script.text: There will be very strong winds, up to one hundred kilometres per hour, and heavy rain.

script.speaker: host
script.text: Please don't drive unless it's necessary, and stay away from the coast.

script.speaker: host
script.text: All ferries tonight are cancelled, but trains are running normally for now.

script.speaker: host
script.text: The storm will finish by tomorrow morning, and the afternoon will be sunny.

questions.prompt: When will the storm arrive in the west?
questions.feedback: Fırtına batıya akşam dokuz civarında gelecek; gece yarısından sonra doğuya geçecek.
questions.evidence: will arrive in the west at about nine p.m.

questions.prompt: How strong will the winds be?
options: up to ten kilometres per hour
up to fifty kilometres per hour
up to one hundred kilometres per hour
up to one thousand kilometres per hour
questions.feedback: Rüzgâr saatte yüz kilometreye kadar çıkacak.
questions.evidence: up to one hundred kilometres per hour

questions.feedback: Gerekmedikçe araba kullanmayın ve kıyıdan uzak durun.
Bu geceki bütün feribotlar iptal; trenler şimdilik normal.

questions.prompt: What will the weather be like tomorrow afternoon?
questions.feedback: Fırtına yarın sabaha biter; öğleden sonra güneşli.
